summary.text: Tim White is the Libertarian candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent William Rabon (R) and Democratic candidate Richard Combes.
White is a financial advisor and U.S. Army veteran.

paragraphs.text: Tim White served in the U.S. Army from 2000 to 2004, earned a high school diploma from Alvirne High School, and attended Brunswick Community College and UNCW, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a financial advisor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, White said he wants to maximize individual rights and liberties while limiting the power and scope of government.

His three listed campaign messages are lowering or eliminating the state income tax and increasing transparency on how tax dollars are used, reforming zoning laws to increase property rights and end eminent domain abuse, and cutting unnecessary regulations on small businesses.
